name: Tsui no Stella Gojitsudan: Kasukana Kibou no Nikki
original_name: 終のステラ後日談：微かな希望の日記
source:
A Chinese doujin game based on the official after story.

The after story unfolds in the form of a diary, set in a post-apocalyptic world. The human protagonist, "Rafe," had a very miserable childhood. Everything changed when he met the courier, Philia.
translation:
一款根据官方After Story改编的中国同人游戏。

之后的故事以日记的形式展开，背景设定在后世界末日的世界。人类主角“Rafe”有着非常悲惨的童年。当他遇到快递员菲莉亚时，一切都改变了。
